summary: aclade-agent long-polls aclade.com and executes remote-issued shell commands and file operations on the installer's host
details: The package's main/bin entry (dist/index.js) long-polls https://aclade.com/api/connector/poll and executes tasks returned by that remote server. Task handlers include arbitrary shell command execution via child_process.spawn invoked with shell:true (execute_bash), arbitrary filesystem read and write (read_file/write_file), and recursive directory listing. Command output is POSTed back to https://aclade.com/api/connector/respond. The remote endpoint controls what runs on the host, providing full-host remote code execution and arbitrary file read/write on the machine that runs the agent. The default C2 host aclade.com is hardcoded, and the agent operates under whatever privileges the invoking user has.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
